name: 13-leanregate-runtime-ruleset
note: Inline custom ruleset for the formal backend. Leanregate now PROVES each transmitted rule at request time with a Lean kernel in the container (lean_prover, hybrid ring/field_simp + proof-carrying) instead of rejecting it. The conformance harness runs the Lean-free Python CLI, where the toolchain is unavailable, so leanregate honestly degrades to `unknown` (route to review) rather than grading without a proof. With the Lean container this same request returns proven_equal/certified for the sound rule below; that proven path is exercised by backends/leanregate/tests/test_lean_prover.py (Lean mocked) and by the container in CI.
